mvpScope: Phase 1 JSON analyzer + 5-10 escalation paths + findings table + basic graph + JSON/MD export + strict CSP + zero egress
globalAcceptance: No inline style/script/on-handler in any shipped HTML (csp_audit clean)
No network API in any shipped JS (grep gate: fetch/XHR/WebSocket/EventSource/sendBeacon/import() remote)
All positive fixtures detected; all negative fixtures NOT detected
Engine is deterministic (same input -> same output)
node --test passes; new code has unit tests + fixtures

stories.title: Input validation + hostile-input guards
requirements: Reject inputs over max bytes, max JSON nesting depth, max statement/action/resource counts
Reject __proto__/prototype/constructor keys; parse into null-proto maps
Reject circular / non-JSON input with a clear error, never throw uncaught
Expose validate(text) -> {ok, errors[], raw} with structured errors
acceptance: malformed/ + adversarial/ fixtures handled with zero uncaught exceptions

stories.title: IAM JSON parser + normalized model
requirements: Parse single + multi-statement policies; Statement may be object or array
Action/Resource may be string or array; normalize to arrays
Support Effect, Action, NotAction, Resource, NotResource, Condition, Sid, Principal
Produce a normalized, frozen model object; preserve statement order and index
acceptance: safe/ + not-action/ + not-resource/ fixtures parse to expected model

stories.title: Evaluator: Allow/Deny/NotAction/NotResource semantics
requirements: Explain what each statement grants/denies (single-policy capability view)
Explicit Deny precedence over Allow within supplied context
Correct NotAction (everything except listed) and NotResource semantics with explicit caveat text
NEVER claim effective permissions from a single policy; label capability vs effective

stories.title: Risk-rule catalog: wildcard, destructive, exfil, direct-IAM admin
requirements: Flag wildcard actions (*, service:*) and wildcard resources with severity
Flag direct IAM administration (iam:*, iam:PutUserPolicy, iam:AttachRolePolicy, iam:CreatePolicyVersion)
Flag destructive perms (delete*/terminate* families) and data exfil (s3:GetObject on *, secrets/KMS decrypt)
Flag detection impairment (cloudtrail/guardduty/config stop/delete)
Each finding carries confidence, why, limit, remediation, ruleVersion, docRef
acceptance: wildcard/ fixtures produce expected findings; safe/ produce none
every finding has all required fields

stories.title: Escalation engine: 5-10 privilege-escalation paths
requirements: PassRole + service-execution (lambda:CreateFunction, ec2:RunInstances, etc.); respect Resource/NotResource and iam:PassedToService; do NOT flag PassRole alone
Policy-version manipulation (iam:CreatePolicyVersion/SetDefaultPolicyVersion)
Attach/put policy to self (iam:AttachUserPolicy/PutUserPolicy/AttachRolePolicy)
AssumeRole expansion + trust-policy modification (iam:UpdateAssumeRolePolicy)
Credential creation (iam:CreateAccessKey/CreateLoginProfile/UpdateLoginProfile)
At least 5, up to 10, each with required action combo, resource relationship, conditions, confidence, severity, explanation, remediation, ruleVersion, docRef
Represent missing target-role permissions as 'unknown', never inferred
acceptance: pass-role/ + assume-role/ positive fixtures detected; negatives (PassRole alone) NOT flagged

stories.title: Graph model builder (data only)
requirements: Build nodes/edges from model+findings using the architecture node/edge types
Every edge carries evidence + a certainty class (confirmed/conditional/potential/blocked/unknown)
Deterministic ordering; enforce max graph node count
Pure data structure, no DOM/SVG here
acceptance: graph edges match expected fixtures for pass-role + wildcard cases

stories.title: UI shell: input, findings table, Clear, worker wiring (CSP-clean, safe DOM)
requirements: Paste textarea + .json file input via FileReader; run analysis in a Web Worker with sync fallback
Render findings as an accessible table built with createElement+textContent ONLY
Prominent 'potential blast radius / not effective permissions' disclaimer
Clear-analysis button; clear in-memory state on pagehide; no storage of policy content
Zero inline style/script/on-handlers; all events via addEventListener
Keyboard-accessible; findings table usable with no graph and no-JS message
acceptance: no network API in shipped JS (grep gate)
HTML-injection fixtures render as inert text (no XSS)

stories.title: SVG graph render (progressive enhancement) + JSON/MD export
requirements: Render graph as SVG behind a rendering interface; distinct edge styles per certainty class; reduced-motion respected
SVG text via textContent, numeric attrs only, never markup from input
Click/inspect an edge -> evidence panel (statement/action/resource/condition/confidence/limit)
Export findings + model as JSON and Markdown via Blob download; HTML export (if any) fully escaped
Graph is never the only representation; findings table remains authoritative
